text: Especially love the compact and sleek design of the homescreen widget which can track data and quick checkin and takes up only small space. However widget lacks the highlight for 'today' as it does in the app, so a bit trouble to see how long it's been since I last did a habit. Would it be possible to add highlight for widgets as well please?
author: Charles Kim
developer_reply: Thanks Charles Kim for your wonderful review. Yes, I’ll add the highlight for today as in the app in the next update. Good luck building those habits :)
